description: Trackwall windows (the main window and extra windows, ADR-49, and the tray panel, ADR-50): the app's commands (daemon_connection, retry_daemon, open_window, window_shows, take_jump, open_link, open_from_tray_panel, pick_projects_folder, and the app update commands check_update and install_update, ADR-53; the updater plugin is used from Rust) and core:default (events, the native context menu of view icons), no system plugin permissions (ADR-51).
